photo: A small, foldable baby crib with a white fabric-covered frame and a breathable mesh side panel. It has no wooden rails or plastic teething parts. The frame collapses into a compact bundle with a carrying strap.

title: Vintage High Chair - Great Condition, Just Need a Seat Cover
text: This old-school high chair is still super sturdy! Looks like it came from the 70s, has a metal frame with a plastic seat. Seat has a little wear but no tears. The metal legs are solid and it doesn’t wobble. I’ve had it in my garage for years, just never used it. Priced low because I need to clear space. Pickup only from my place in Oak Park, IL. $25 obo.
photo: A beige plastic high chair seat with a metal frame, slightly rusted at the base of the legs, sitting on a wooden floor. The seat has a small crack near the edge. A faded yellow flower pattern is printed on the seat. The metal column is welded to a flat metal plate underneath.

title: Old Metal High Chair - Works Great, Just Needs a New Seat Pad
text: Found this in the garage—looks like a classic 70s high chair. Metal frame, plastic seat, no folding parts. Seat is a little scuffed but still holds up. Legs are thick and solid, doesn’t wobble at all. I think it’s from the 70s, maybe early 80s? Not sure, but it’s functional and safe-looking. $15 cash, pickup in downtown Evanston. No shipping.
photo: A high chair with a dark green plastic seat and a chrome-colored metal frame. The seat is rectangular with a slight curve, and the metal column is welded to a flat metal base plate. The chair sits upright on four short legs with rubber feet. One leg has a small dent.

title: Nokexora Home Classic High Chair - Retro Design, Sturdy Frame
text: Love this vintage high chair from Nokexora Home! Super sturdy metal frame, easy to clean plastic seat. Great for feeding babies or toddlers. Only minor scuffing on the seat. It’s been cleaned and tested—still holds weight just fine. I bought it from a thrift store and thought it was a unique find. $30, pickup only in Des Plaines. No returns.
photo: A high chair with a bright yellow plastic seat and a black metal frame. The metal column is welded to a flat metal plate at the bottom. The seat has a geometric print in navy blue. The chair stands on four short legs with rubber tips. One leg is slightly bent.

title: Folding High Chair with Canopy - Modern & Lightweight
text: This lightweight folding high chair is perfect for travel! Has a padded seat, built-in tray, and a sunshade. Easy to carry and store. Only used a few times—clean and in great shape. $50, pickup in Naperville. Great for parents on the go!
photo: A modern, foldable high chair with a white plastic seat and a bright blue canopy. The frame is a lightweight aluminum structure with a foldable hinge. The seat has a floral print and a removable tray.

title: Wooden High Chair with Adjustable Height - Antique Style
text: Beautiful vintage wooden high chair from the 1950s. Solid oak, smooth finish, adjustable seat height. The backrest is curved and has a carved design. Still very sturdy. I bought it at a flea market—looks like it came from a classic nursery. $120, pickup in Evanston.
photo: A wooden high chair with a dark walnut finish and a curved backrest. The seat is made of solid wood with a slightly raised edge. It has no metal parts and stands on four tapered wooden legs. A small brass knob is visible near the seat base.
